title: Ferman e Mustafa Say Anjan O Musalman
body:
Ferman e Mustafa say anjan o musalmaa’n..
<<DIVIDER>>
Sani)
Tukra hoon main Nabi ka pehchan o musalmaa’n..
<<DIVIDER>>
Antra)
Oh hasbona kay mufti jhutla rahay ho mujhko
Utra hai meray ghar main Quran o musalmaa’n..
<<DIVIDER>>
Antra)
Tehreer e Mustafa yeh Quran say kam nahin hai
Hizyan kay laga na bohtan o musalmaa’n..
<<DIVIDER>>
Antra)
Mujrim ho meray tum tou qazi banay huey ho
Bagh e Fidak hai tera arman o musalmaa’n..
<<DIVIDER>>
Antra)
Bughz e Ali ka khencha rukh say naqab teray
Dozakh teri ka hai yeh saman o musalmaa’n..
<<DIVIDER>>
Antra)
Ban gaye ghani hain meray tukro pay palnay walay
Kaisya bhulaye tum nay ehsan o musalmaa’n..
<<DIVIDER>>
Antra)
Zahra say dushmani aur jannat ki hai talab bhi
Rakhtay ho kaisi khuwahish nadan o musalmaa’n..
<<DIVIDER>>
Antra)
Bibi Batool jis per razi Raza na ho tou
Kerta hai us pay lanat Rehman o musalmaa’n..
